name: A10-0290/2026 – Emma Ytterell – Article 7, § 1, point d, after § 2 – Am 123
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
section: Article 7 – paragraph 1 – point d – paragraph 2 a (new)
part_text: If, by the end of the period specified in point (d), first subparagraph, the competent authority has neither confirmed that the application is complete nor provided the project promoter with a written and reasoned statement specifying which information required for the environmental assessment is missing, the period specified in point (e) shall start upon the expiry of the period specified in point (d), first subparagraph. If the time limit referred to in point (d), first subparagraph, has been extended in accordance with Article 7(1), third subparagraph, the period specified in point (e) shall start upon the expiry of the extended time limit. The expiry of those time limits shall not be deemed to constitute either a confirmation of completeness or an approval of the project. The competent authority shall conduct the environmental review required under Union law and shall, in every case, issue a reasoned conclusion.
